description: NAICS CODE: 541715 FEDERAL AGENCY NAME: Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL - Rome Research Site, AFRL/Information Directorate, 26 Electronic Parkway, Rome, NY, 13441-4514 BAA ANNOUNCEMENT TYPE: Initial announcement BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT (BAA) TITLE: Artificial Intelligence and Next Generation Distributed Command and Control BAA NUMBER: FA8750-23-S-7006 PART I � OVERVIEW INFORMATION This announcement is for an Open, 2 Step BAA which is open and effective until 30 AUG 2028. Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 1600 hours Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 30 AUG 2028, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY24 by 13 SEP 2023 FY25 by 15 Mar 2024 FY26 by 15 Mar 2025 FY27 by 15 Mar 2026 FY28 by 15 Mar 2027 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. CONCISE SUMMARY OF TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT: Artificial Intelligence (AI) holds great potential in transforming the Department of the Air Force (DAF) and Joint Force Command and Control (C2) capabilities across strategic, operational, and tactical levels by enabling decision makers to effectively assess the battlespace, rapidly explore, create, and select the best plan, and direct and monitor forces at pace and scale in a distributed setting. This BAA is interested in exploring new and advancing existing AI and distributed C2 concepts. By accelerating the research & development of novel AI-based and distributed capabilities to support Joint All Domain C2, the DAF can achieve a strategic decision advantage, where AI becomes a key and prevalent component to future C2 systems. With the rise of AI-based applications also comes new challenges to include the ability to effectively manage, monitor, and adapt deployed AI capabilities and effective C2 in a distributed and contested environment. Distributed operations is a critical component of Next-Generation C2. Key to the DAF transitioning from a single monolithic C2 node to multiple distributed C2 nodes is the ability orchestrate operational processes, while optimizing for limited resources. Through the development of distributed C2 capabilities the DAF can achieve an agile, fully mobile, distributed, and virtualized C2 operational capability. This BAA is interested in key areas for advancing C2 capability for the DAF to include but not limited to development and application of AI to C2, new concepts and techniques for the battle management and orchestration of AI at pace and scale, how the use of AI by adversaries can be considered in the C2 planning and execution process and distributed and collaborative C2 to enable C2 anywhere and anyplace. title: ADVANCED RESEARCH ANNOUNCEMENT (ARA) TITLE: ADVANCED TRACKING ARCHITECTURE USING AI (ATA-AI)
description: NAICS CODE: 541715 FEDERAL AGENCY NAME: Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL - Rome Research Site, AFRL/Information Directorate, 26 Electronic Parkway, Rome, NY, 13441-4514 ARA ANNOUNCEMENT TYPE: Initial Announcement ADVANCED RESEARCH ANNOUNCEMENT (ARA) TITLE: ADVANCED TRACKING ARCHITECTURE USING AI (ATA-AI) BAA or ARA NUMBER: FA8750-24-S-7004 PART I � OVERVIEW INFORMATION This announcement is for an Open, 2 Step ARA which is open and effective until 12 July 2029. Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 5pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 12 July 2029, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY25 by 30 NOV 2024 FY26 by 30 NOV 2025 FY27 by 30 NOV 2026 FY28 by 30 NOV 2027 FY29 by 30 NOV 2028 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. CONCISE SUMMARY OF TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT: Seeking research to design, develop, test, evaluate, and deliver innovative technologies and techniques for Next Generation Target Tracking architectures, which exploit a wide array of data sources and leverage the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Machine Inferencing (MI) algorithms in a High Performance Computing (HPC) enabled framework. ARA ESTIMATED FUNDING: Total funding for this ARA is approximately $99M. Individual awards will not normally exceed 48 months with dollar amounts normally ranging from $1M to $10M. There is also the potential to make awards up to any dollar value as long as the value does not exceed the available ARA ceiling amount. ANTICIPATED INDIVIDUAL AWARDS: Multiple Awards are anticipated. However, the Air Force reserves the right to award zero, one, or more Procurement Contracts or Other Transactions, for all, some, or none of the solicited effort based on the offeror�s ability to perform desired work and funding fluctuations. There is no limit on the number of OTs that may be awarded to an individual offeror. TYPE OF INSTRUMENTS THAT MAY BE AWARDED: FAR based procurement contracts or other transactions (OT) under 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022 and 10 USC 4023 (previously 10 USC 4002, 2371, 10 USC 4003, 2371b and 4004, 2373) In the event that an Other Transaction for Prototype agreement is awarded as a result of this competitive ARA, and the prototype project is successfully completed, there is the potential for a prototype project to transition to award of a follow-on production contract or transaction. The Other Transaction for Prototype agreement itself will also contain a similar notice of a potential follow-on production contract or agreement. AGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION: All white paper submissions and any questions of a technical nature shall be directed to the cognizant Technical Point of Contact (TPOC) as specified below (unless otherwise specified in the technical area): ARA PROGRAM MANAGER: Carolyn Sheaff AFRL/RIED 525 Brooks Rd Rome, NY 13441-4505 Email: AFRL.RIEDBAA.2024@us.af.mil ARA DEPUTY PROGRAM MANAGER: Peter Rocci AFRL/RIED 525 Brooks Rd Rome, NY 13441-4505 Email: AFRL.RIEDBAA.2024@us.af.mil Questions of a contractual/business nature shall be directed to the cognizant contracting officer, as specified below (email requests are preferred): Amber Buckley Email: Amber.Buckley@us.af.mil Emails must reference the solicitation ARA number and title of the acquisition. Pre-Proposal Communication between Prospective Offerors and Government Representatives: Dialogue between prospective offerors and Government representatives is encouraged. Technical and contracting questions can be resolved in writing through email. Communications with any of the points of contact shall not constitute a commitment by the Government to subsequently fund or award any proposed effort. Only Contracting Officers are legally authorized to commit the Government. Offerors are cautioned that evaluation ratings may be lowered and/or proposal rejected if proposal preparation (Proposal format, content, etc.) and/or submittal instructions are not followed. PLEASE SEE THE ATTACHMENT FOR FULL ANNOUNCEMENT DETAILS. Amendment No. 1 to ARA FA8750-24-S-7004 The purpose of this amendment is to: Section III, Paragraph 5, updates S&T Protection language; Section V, paragraph 2.e, updates the language regarding the S&T review; SEE ATTACHMENT FOR FULL AMENDMENT DETAILS Amendment No. 2 to BAA FA8750-24-S-7004 The purpose of this amendment is to: Part II, FULL TEXT ANNOUNCEMENT, adds language regarding Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Act (FASCSA) Orders; Section VI, paragraph 11, updates FINANCIAL RESOURCES requirements language; FULL TEXT ANNOUNCEMENT: Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Act (FASCSA) Orders: As of the date of this solicitation amendment, there are no applicable FASCSA orders. This requirement only applies to FAR based awards. SECTION VI: 11. FINANCIAL RESOURCES: Proposals shall include information to determine adequate financial resources to perform the effort, taking into consideration all existing commercial and governmental business commitments. See DFARS 232.072-2(b) for a list of the types of information used to support financial responsibility. Examples include financial statements (e.g. Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, Compensation); disclosures of previous insolvency; business case/cash flow forecasts; financing arrangements; and/or letters of good standing from accredited financial institutions. Proposals shall also include all significant ratios as outlined in DFARS 232.072-2(b)(10)(i)-(vi). This requirement only applies to FAR based awards. No other changes are made. AMENDMENT 3 to ARA FA8750-24-S-7004 The purpose of this modification is to republish the original announcement, incorporating any previous amendments, pursuant to FAR 35.016(c). This republishing also includes the following changes: Part II, Full Text Announcement: Section III.2.b.2, updates the FOCI guidance; Section IV.2, updates Content and Format; Section IV.4,b, updates the SAM provision date; Section VI.1, updates proposal formatting language; Section VI.3, updates debriefing language; Section VI.7, updates the provisions; Section VI., adds paragraph 9; Section VII: updates the OMBUDSMAN. No other changes have been made. Amendment No. 4 to ARA FA8750-24-S-7004 The purpose of this amendment is to: Part II, FULL TEXT ANNOUNCEMENT, updates the language regarding Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act (FASCSA) Orders; FULL TEXT ANNOUNCEMENT: Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act (FASCSA) Orders: Depending on the date of issuance of this solicitation, FASCSA order(s) may be applicable. Therefore, the Offeror shall search for the phrase �FASCSA order� in the System for Award Management (SAM) (https://www.sam.gov) for any covered article, or any products or services produced or provided by a source, if there is an applicable Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act Orders prohibition. This requirement only applies to FAR based awards. No other changes are made.

description: Welcome to the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program and adjacent subjects. Note: This Dynamic Purchasing System is a continuation on the Mercell platform of the DPS that was previously operational on the Negometrix platform with Negometrix reference 159478 for which formal notice 2021/S 087-226573 was published on 5-May-2021 on the TED website. If your company was already qualified for participation on the Negometrix platform, a simplified procedure applies for re-establishing your qualification, see question 2.1 on the Mercell platform. TenneT will renew and innovate the (IT) systems that it uses for controlling and balancing its grids in the period 2021-2031. In connection with this, TenneT expects to be needing extensive external expertise, related to existing and new technologies and ways of working, in particular related to the challenges that TenneT faces in the energy transition. Compared to current ways of working, innovations will be needed to handle e.g. the increasing infeed of solar and wind energy that is far more difficult to predict and control than traditional generation. The subject of this tender procedure is a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for expertise (including the development of algorithms and IT Tools) that TenneT needs in connection with the renewal of its (IT) systems related to the control and balancing of the electricity transmission grid. Initially, the DPS contains the following categories of expertise: 1. power system control and monitoring; 2. energy platforms and interconnected IT systems; 3. data analysis, artificial intelligence and machine learning; 4. system and process implementation. This Tender Dossier contains the rules for the Application by Economic operators for qualification under this DPS. In order to become qualified for one or more of the categories, the Economic operator has to fulfil all the requirements of this DPS. In addition, the Economic operator needs to the answer all Mercell questions, and submit the requested documents and-or evidence at the respective Mercell question with the submission of its Application. During the course of time, the specific assignments (contracts) under the DPS will be tendered for which all suppliers that have qualified for the particular category will be invited to submit an offer. Any interested supplier may at any moment during the lifetime of the DPS submit a request to be qualified for participating in the tender procedures for specific assignments within one or more of the categories of this DPS. Your request will be accepted if it satisfies the applicable requirements and if you accept the stated conditions. Once you have qualified, you will automatically receive a notification when TenneT publishes a request for proposal for a specific subject within a category for which you have qualified. TenneT emphasises that it would also like to attract small and medium sized companies to this DPS. Qualification requests will be processed by TenneT in the sequence of receipt. TenneT will inform you as soon as possible and endeavors to do so within 10 working days from the date of receipt about the acceptance or rejection of your qualification request. During the lifetime of the DPS, TenneT will be entitled to add new categories, to close existing categories, and to split-up existing categories in to one or more categories.

title: France – Advertising and marketing services – Prestations de communication numérique touristique et d'attractivité-.
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la structuration et la planification d’une communication numérique dédiée à la promotion des atouts touristiques de Troyes Champagne Métropole. Cette stratégie doit reposer principalement sur un vécu expérientiel dans lequel les prospects et repeaters (visiteurs récurrents) vont se projeter et s’identifier. Pour ce faire, les prestations attendues au titre de ce marché reposent sur une stratégie de promotion numérique sur Internet et les réseaux sociaux (dont ceux de l’Office du tourisme, de la ville de Troyes et de Troyes Champagne Métropole) et pouvant être déclinés en spots télévisés segmentés et replay. Conformément à l’article L2113-10 du Code de la commande publique, la présente consultation est allotie comme suit : Lot n°1 : Création et mise au format de visuels publicitaires ; Lot n°2 : Réalisation de vidéos et prise de photos ; Lot n°3 : Média planning et stratégie de diffusion numérique ; En application de l’article R2113-1 du Code de la commande publique, les opérateurs économiques peuvent soumissionner pour les 3 lots. Les 3 lots susvisés peuvent être attribués à un seul et même opérateur économique. Conformément aux dispositions des articles L2125-1.1°, R. 2162-1 à R. 2162-6 et R. 2162-13 à R. 2162-14 du Code de la Commande Publique, chaque lot donnera lieu, à la conclusion d’un accord-cadre mono-attributaire à bons de commande. Le titulaire de l’accord-cadre sera consulté, à chaque survenance d’un besoin, par le biais de l’émission de bons de commande, conformément aux dispositions des articles R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du Code de la Commande Publique. En application de l’article R.2162-4-2° du Code de la Commande Publique, l’accord-cadre sera conclu avec les montants maximum suivants : - S’agissant du lot n°1 : un montant maximum de 40 000 € HT annuel ; - S’agissant du lot n°2 : un montant maximum de 60 000 € HT annuel ; - S’agissant du lot n°3 : un montant maximum de 80 000 € HT annuel. Pour chaque lot, la durée de validité du présent marché court à compter de sa date de notification pour une durée d’un an. Celui-ci est reconductible, 3 fois par voie tacite, par période de 12 mois. Le titulaire du marché public ne pourra refuser la reconduction conformément aux dispositions de l’article R2112-4 du Code de la commande publique. En cas de non-reconduction, un courrier sera adressé au(x) titulaire(s) du marché public au moins un mois avant l’échéance de ce dernier. Pour chaque lot, les délais d’exécution seront fixés au sein de chaque bon de commande.

The NUWC Systems Engineering Division is responsible for: developing alteration installation packages supporting upgrades; fielding systems through the alteration installation process; preparing, planning, and providing conformance documentation to support the installation of various alterations; conducting pre- and post- installation testing; publishing alteration installation results and completion reports; and, maintaining a Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) approved Alteration Installation Team (AIT) Quality Assurance Program and Process. The contemplated contract will be Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF), utilizing full and open competition to allow any qualified prime contract holder to propose. It will be awarded on a best-value basis to the Government. A trade-off analysis will be carried out, taking into consideration technical capability, past performance, and cost/price. title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. As part of the Army�s continuous transformation effort, initiatives are being implemented to transform how the Army operates, trains, and equips for C2 capabilities that enhance its lethality, mobility, and survivability in large-scale combat as part of the Joint Force. description: Background Arendal municipality has an ongoing need for graphical services connected to information material and visual communication aimed at inhabitants and internal target groups. Minor assignments means limited deliveries such as, for example, an ad, poster, presentation or simple illustration. The deliveries shall be able to be used further in the municipality ́s own channels and tools, and it is important that the deliveries can be further developed and adapted internally. The framework agreement shall also include the design of profile material and profile articles, as well as graphic materials connected to the use of, among other things, vehicles, buildings and work clothes. description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Scope van de opdracht De opdracht omvat de integrale postdienstverlening voor de gemeente Breda, waaronder in ieder geval: het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van geadresseerde poststukken; het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van pakketten; het verwerken en bezorgen van verkiezingspost; het verwerken van retourzendingen; Haalservice (postbus)post en Brengservcie (postbus)post; het verzorgen van aangetekende poststukken (Binnenland en Buitenland) en overige bijzondere postdiensten; het verzorgen van kwaliteitsborging en prestatiemonitoring. De exacte omvang en inhoud van de dienstverlening zijn nader uitgewerkt in het Programma van Eisen en de SLA. Buiten de scope valt: verspreiding huis aan huis berichten (gemeentelijke berichten) en fietskoersdiensten. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het afsluiten van een raamovereenkomst met één contractpartij voor het verzorgen van de postdienstverlening ten behoeve van gemeente Breda. Deze raamovereenkomst zal worden aangegaan voor een periode van 2 jaar. De ingangsdatum van deze raamovereenkomst is 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze raamovereenkomst tegen dezelfde voorwaarden en condities twee (2) maal te verlengen, telkens voor de duur van één (1) jaar. title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

title: Netherlands – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Supply and Analysis of NH₃ Passive Samplers (Diffusion Tubes) for the MAN Network and additional projects
description: This European tender concerns a contract for the supply and laboratory analysis of ammonia (NH₃) passive samplers (diffusion tubes) for the Dutch ammonia monitoring network “Meetnet Ammoniak Nederland” (MAN) and various additional projects. The contractor will be responsible for the monthly supply of unexposed diffusion tubes to RIVM, the analysis of exposed tubes supplied by RIVM, and the digital reporting of validated results. Field deployment, return logistics of exposed tubes and internal data processing by RIVM fall outside the scope. The expected annual volume ranges from approximately 6,600 tubes in the baseline MAN scenario up to around 9,900 tubes including additional projects, with a maximum bandwidth of up to 30,000 tubes per year to accommodate future growth. If the contract is awarded to a new supplier, the first contract year will include a structured Double Measurement Programme, in which the new laboratory’s performance is systematically compared with the current trend laboratory to ensure continuity and trend stability in the MAN data series. description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europeesopenbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht Een van de taken van de gemeente is handhaving op parkeren. De gemeente Breda voert deze handhaving in eigen beheer uit. Daarbij worden sinds 2019 scanauto’s ingezet. Hierbij worden naheffingsaanslagen uitgeschreven. Deze naheffingen dienen geïnd te worden. Deze uitvraag betreft de oplegging en inning/invordering van de door de gemeente uitgeschreven naheffingsaanslagen voor zowel Nederlandse als buitenlandse kentekens. Verder kan er bezwaar gemaakt worden tegen deze naheffingen. De afhandeling van deze bezwaarschriften en de afhandeling van eventuele daarop volgende beroepschriften vormen eveneens onderdeel van deze opdracht. Ter indicatie zijn hierbij de cijfers van 2024. Het betreft de volgende aantallen NHA’s: Nederlandse kentekens: 110.000 Belgische kentekens: 11.000 Duitse kentekens: 1.500 andere landen kentekens: 5.000 27.755 bezwaren per jaar 88 beroepszaken per jaar De indicatie van de verwachte aantallen is ontleend aan de huidige situatie. Benadrukt wordt dat de omvang een indicatie is waaraan geen rechten ontleend kunnen worden. De werkelijke omvang van de opdracht kan dus in positieve of negatieve zin afwijken van de genoemde indicatie. Een doelmatige periodieke rapportage van de uitgevoerde activiteiten behoort eveneens tot de scope. De gemeente verwacht van de te contracteren partij dat ingespeeld wordt op nieuwe ontwikkelingen en wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving. Deze partij communiceert bijvoorbeeld proactief wanneer invordering in meerdere/nieuwe landen mogelijk wordt. De te contracteren partij verstuurt de NHA’s, waarbij de vormgeving in samenwerking met de gemeente tot stand komt, o.a. dat op de uitgeschreven NHA’s verwezen naar de uitvoerende partij voor de bezwaarmogelijkheden, dit dient in tekst en d.m.v. een QR duidelijk te worden. De gemeente zorgt ervoor dat op haar website verwezen wordt naar de bezwaarmogelijkheden bij opdrachtnemer. De gemeente is op zoek naar een partij die een snelle en efficiënte afhandeling van de invorderingsdossiers en bezwarencases kan borgen, waarbij klantvriendelijkheid hoog in het vaandel staat. Wetende dat niemand ‘blij’ wordt van een naheffing, is juist bij de klantcontacten een klantvriendelijke en waar nodig de-escalerende benadering voor de gemeente van belang. De gemeente Breda is momenteel bezig met het opstellen van een wielklembeleid. Momenteel is de gemeente bezig met de eerste onderzoekende fase. Het is mogelijk dat tijdens het contract of net voor het vastleggen van het contract meer informatie beschikbaar is over het invoeren van het wielklembeleid. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen: Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de levering van deze diensten een raamovereenkomst te sluiten. De overeenkomst treedt in werking na ondertekening en heeft een looptijd van twee (2) jaar na het moment van livegang op 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze twee (2) maal met één (1) jaar te verlengen. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestatie. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 995.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

title: Norway – Research and development consultancy services – Competence brokering (FoUI guideline) Oslo
description: The core of the delivery is FoUI guidance as described below. Oslo municipality also requests an option for other services. The objective of the procurement is to enter into a contract with 4-7 FoUI guides for selected input areas. The FoUI guideline shall strengthen research supported innovation in the region ́s businesses and the municipality ́s own activities. The effort shall strengthen capacity for innovation in business and shall also contribute to strengthening Oslo municipality ́s own capacity for research-supported innovation, in line with the approved strategy for knowledge based development, innovation and digital technology for Oslo municipality (KID). Business orientated efforts will be prioritised, among other things, in accordance with the regional plan for competitiveness and value creation in Oslo and Akershus, which is at a hearing in autumn 2026. Special emphasis will be placed on competence for business, the public sector and research within: · Sustainable restructuring and systems for the green shift. · Public Health, Health and Life Sciences · Digitalisation and artificial intelligence · Stand-by, Security and Civil Protection It is an advantage to refer to in-depth knowledge of industries that are strategically important for Oslo, such as maritime, digitalisation, health, dual-use and circular economy. Artificial intelligence and digitalisation are in the process of taking in all parts of business and society. Knowledge on digitalisation and artificial intelligence is therefore not limited to one priority area, and it will be advantageous to be able to use digitalisation and AI within the individual commitment areas. The R&D guides have the main assignment of mobilising businesses and Oslo ́s own entities for more research-supported R&D. The R&D guides discuss project ideas and possibilities with companies or the public sector and can connect R&D needs with relevant researchers. The FoUI guideline mobilises to regional, national and international schemes, as well as for preliminary projects and the subsidy scheme SmartOslo. New this time is that we want the FoUI guidelines to also be able to contribute to mobilising to EU support schemes for businesses, including EIC.

Implementarea unui modul destinat gestionării automate a pontajelor, concediilor și statisticilor de prezență, optimizând astfel procesele administrative interne. - SOLUȚIE DE RESURSE UMANE ➢ 3. Utilizarea tehnologiei avansate pentru a înregistra ședințele oficiale și a transforma automat înregistrările audio în transcrieri scrise, facilitând astfel accesul la informații. - SOLUȚIE DE ÎNREGISTRARE, DOCUMENTARE ȘI DISEMINARE A ȘEDINȚELOR ➢ 4. Crearea unor canale diverse de comunicare pentru cetățeni, inclusiv chatbots pentru asistență non-stop și implementarea unui sistem de bugetare participativă, permițând cetățenilor să se implice activ în deciziile administrative - SOLUȚIE DE COMUNICARE CU CETĂȚENII ȘI BUGETARE PARTICIPATIVĂ ➢ 5. Oferirea de materiale educative și sesiuni informative pentru a conștientiza cetățenii despre importanța participării lor în procesul bugetării, precum și despre alte subiecte relevante pentru comunitate - SOLUȚIE DE EDUCARE ȘI DEZVOLTARE DURABILĂ Durata contractului: Durata de prestare a serviciilor prevăzute în prezentul contract este de 6 luni până la recepția finală a serviciilor, începând de la data semnării contractului de către ambele părți sub rezerva constituirii garantiei de buna executie. Termenul pentru recepția cantitativă a soluției este de maxim 5 luni iar termenul pentru recepția calitativă este de cel mult 6 luni calculat de la data semnării contractului de către ambele părți, sub rezerva constituirii garanției de buna execuție. Termenii și condițiile contractului includ și o garanție de cel puțin 2 ani. Perioada de garanție decurge de la data recepției finale şi este egală cel puțin cu perioadele stabilite în caietul de sarcini. Miercurea Ciuc și Comuna Leliceni.” intră sub incidența reglementărilor Comisiei Europene 2021/C 373/01 - ”Orientări tehnice referitoare la imunizarea infrastructurii la schimbările climatice în perioada 2021-2027” privind imunizarea la schimbările climatice, fiind încadrat în categoria de ” alte tipuri de infrastructură eligibile”. title: Street Light Repair Project

The works comprise repairs, refurbishment and replacement items identified within the Council's electrical and structural assessment. Total price for repairs and remedial works. Total price for heritage refurbishment and painting. Price for inspection and any remedial works relating to Asset 50. Itemised costs for each individual asset, including labour, materials, plant and traffic management where applicable. Details of any exclusions, assumptions or provisional sums. title: Netherlands – Articulated trucks – Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem CLAS - Matlogco - Witte Vloot
description: Bedrijfsprofiel De Aanbestedende dienst is het Materieellogistiek Commando Land (MatlogCo) van de Koninklijke Landmacht - een van de zeven onderdelen van het Ministerie van Defensie. Het MatlogCo is verantwoordelijk voor de instandhouding van het grondgebonden materieel van Defensie. Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie en het MatlogCo is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De hierbij gebruikte procedure is het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem uit de Aanbestedingswet 2012. De procedure verloopt volledig elektronisch via het online aanbestedingsplatform Negometrix. Een Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS) is een elektronisch proces voor het doen van gangbare aankopen van werken, leveringen of diensten, waarvan de kenmerken wegens de algemene beschikbaarheid op de markt voldoen aan onze behoeften. Doelstelling DAS De doelstelling van het DAS is een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe te laten zonder de beheersbaarheid te verliezen. Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Voor deze aanbesteding volgt Defensie de Europese aanbestedingsprocedure 'Dynamisch aankoopsysteem', conform de Aanbestedingswet. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar twee fasen: 1. Instellingsfase 2. Gunningsfase Deze fasen worden nader uitgewerkt in vragenlijst 1.1. Kort samengevat Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot het DAS houdt geen opdracht in; Het MatlogCo plaats een nadere uitvraag; Deelnemer schrijft in; Het MatlogCo beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige Inschrijving. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem Bij de publicatie in maart 2023 had het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS) een initiële looptijd van 48 maanden. Echter, aangezien deze DAS een voortzetting is van de vorige DAS met het negometrix nummer 210681, resteert er nu nog een looptijd van 35 maanden. Het is belangrijk op te merken dat de Aanbestedende Dienst de looptijd één keer kan verlengen, met een periode van 48 maanden. Het staat de Aanbestedende dienst vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd producten en/of kwalificaties toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de Aanbestedende dienst waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

title: Ireland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Panel for the provision of Architect Led Services for projects of less than €1 million (ex. VAT) in value
description: Dublin City Council is establishing a Panel for the provision of Architectural Services for projects of less than €1 million (ex. VAT) in value. Panel members will be required to provide architectural design and associated services for stages (i)-(v) of the Capital Works Management Framework (CWMF) or a subset thereof. As part of the service delivery, panel members will be required to provide the following minimum specialist services: • Design Team Lead, • Architect, • Employer’s Representative for works contracts, • Design Certifier (under the Building Control Amendment Regulations 2014) • Assigned Certifier (under the Building Control Amendment Regulations 2014) • PSDP Additional optional specialist services that may be required include Measured Surveys; Condition Surveys; Architectural Conservation Consultancy Services; Accessibility Audits; Design Services for Disability Access Certificates and Fire Safety Consultancy Services. It is intended that the architectural services to be provided will cover the following project types: feasibility studies, residential (new build and refurbishment), public realm, precinct improvements, housing, civic, community, recreational, sports, infrastructural improvement master-planning, mixed use/commercial etc. The services will cover any and all (CWMF) work stages. Only those Applicants capable of delivering all of the minimum specialist services listed above (whether in-house or as a grouping/consortium) will be considered. Therefore, applications relating to one or several of these services only are not acceptable and will be rejected Every effort has been made to ensure that this document contains all the necessary information for the completion of applications. The Contracting Authority does not warrant or represent that this document, or any other information given to Applicants, is accurate or complete. No liability is accepted for any error, misstatement, or omission (negligent or otherwise) in this document, or in any other information given to Applicants. title: Finland – Training and entertainment software development services – HAUS DPS 2026–2030 for Digital Transformation, Innovation and Public Sector Development
description: HAUS Finnish Institute of Public Management Ltd (HAUS) is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for the period 2026–2030 for the procurement of expert services related to digital transformation, innovation, governance, institutional development and public sector development. The estimated total value of procurements conducted under the DPS during its validity period is approximately EUR 40 million (excluding VAT). The DPS will be used to procure expertise for international development cooperation projects, technical assistance assignments, advisory services, capacity building initiatives, studies, evaluations and other expert services implemented globally. Assignments may be funded by, among others, the European Union, the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland, development finance institutions and other international cooperation partners. Suppliers may apply to one or several categories and, once admitted, will have the opportunity to participate in mini-competitions launched throughout the DPS period 2026–2030. Further information regarding the scope, eligibility requirements and application process is provided in the procurement documents.

description: U kunt inschrijven op Inhuurdesk Werken in Noord-Holland Noord Inhuur van tijdelijk personeel De gemeente Schagen maakt per 26 september 2026 voor de inhuur van tijdelijk personeel gebruik van Inhuurdesk Werken in Noord-Holland Noord Conform de nieuwe richtlijnen voor de Aanbestedingswet 2012 is deze inhuurdesk ingericht als Dynamisch Aankoop Systeem (DAS) voor de categorieën: Administratief/secretarieel Automatisering/ICT/GEO/Gis Bestuurlijk Binnendienst/algemene dienst Bouwkunde & Civiele techniek Buitendienst & Groenvoorziening Burger- en publiekszaken Dienstverlening & Facilitair Financieel & Economisch Gezondheidszorg Griffie Hydrologie/ ecologie Juridisch Management & Bedrijfsvoering Onderwijs Openbare Orde en Veiligheid Personeel & Organisatie Ruimtelijke ordening & Milieu Sociale zaken & Werkgelegenheid Sport & Recreatie Techniek (E, WTB, Proces) Vergunning & Handhaving Verkeer & Vervoer Verkoop & Inkoop Voorlichting & Communicatie Welzijn Wetenschap & Cultuur. Deze categorieën zijn het totaal van alle door de aangesloten organisatie gebruikte categorieën. De aangesloten organisatie behoudt zich het recht voor om op een later moment categorieën toe te voegen of te wijzigen. Toevoegingen en/of wijzigingen zullen worden gepubliceerd op Mercell , TenderNed en de website van gemeente Schagen. Omvang Het aantal opdrachten, vanaf schaal 10 Cao gemeenten, is ongeveer 20 op jaarbasis, hieraan kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Ook kunnen gedurende de looptijd nieuwe organisaties aan dit Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem worden toegevoegd. Looptijd Het DAS voor Inhuurdesk Werken in Noord-Holland Noord wordt ingesteld voor een periode van 2 jaar tot 26 september 2028. Daarna is de optie om 2 maal met een periode van één jaar te verlengen. Het DAS loopt dan uiterlijk op 26 september 2030 af. Inschrijven Om in aanmerking te komen voor toekomstige opdrachten kunnen leveranciers en zelfstandigen zich inschrijven en een verzoek tot toelating indienen voor een of meerdere categorieën waarvoor men in aanmerking wenst te komen. description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. Prospective offerors are advised that the teleconference will be held solely for the purpose of explaining the FACE Technical Standard as it relates to this solicitation. description: La présente consultation a pour objet la conclusion d'un contrat de délégation de service public ayant pour objet la gestion et l’exploitation du camping municipal de la commune de Saint-Sever. Le service assure l'accueil des campeurs, la gestion des réservations, l'entretien des installations, l'encaissement des redevances et l'ensemble des prestations nécessaires au bon fonctionnement et entretien du camping. Le Concessionnaire aura notamment pour mission d’assurer : - L’amélioration continue des équipements et services du camping mis à disposition (sanitaires, accueil, aire de jeux et plateau sportif, point de restauration, distributeurs de boissons et snacking en dehors des ouvertures du point de restauration, services extérieurs comme la location de vélos électriques par exemple, des propositions d’activités en lien avec l’Adour et les berges …) - La gestion et l’exploitation du camping, caravaning, avec 70 emplacements minimum avec mobil’homes (dont 2 lodges) avec une montée en gamme des équipements existants. - Le classement aujourd’hui en trois étoiles doit être à minima maintenu voire amélioré en fonction de la proposition du délégataire - la modernisation des installations par la création d’une aire de camping-cars de 10 places minimum et le développement des services associés - la mise en oeuvre de la plantation de 50 arbres pour les emplacements non ombragés aujourd’hui, en coordination avec le service de la commune sur le choix des essences, les techniques de plantation et l’implantation des arbres - la promotion et la commercialisation des équipements sur des sites internet et plateformes de réservations d’hébergements touristiques et réseaux sociaux - l’entretien des ouvrages et bien matériels et immobiliers mis à disposition - l’accueil du public

title: Belgium – Time accounting or human resources software development services – Accord-cadre de services pour l'acquisition d'un logiciel intégré de gestion des ressources humaines
description: Le présent marché constitue un accord-cadre mono-attributaire au sens de la réglementation relative aux marchés publics. Il fixe les conditions applicables aux prestations récurrentes ainsi qu’aux prestations et développements complémentaires qui pourront être commandés au fur et à mesure des besoins du pouvoir adjudicateur pendant sa durée. L’accord-cadre a pour objet la fourniture, la mise en oeuvre, la maintenance, le support et l’évolution d’un système intégré de gestion des ressources humaines, couvrant notamment : • la gestion complète de la paie des agents contractuels, statutaires, mandataires, bénévoles et rentiers (y compris gestion des primes, des absences, des interruptions de carrière, des jetons de présence, des déclarations fiscales et sociales, etc.) ; • la gestion du temps et des présences, incluant les badgeages, la validation des congés, l’encodage et la validation du télétravail, la gestion des missions, la planification, ainsi que l’accès agent via portail web et application mobile. title: Letter of Interest / Advance Notice to Industry Multidisciplinary Environmental Services RFSO
description: AMENDMENT 03– PUBLICATION OF THE LIST OF INTERESTED SUPPLIERS AMENDMENT 02 – PUBLICATION OF THE PRESENTATION AND QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS (Q&A) FROM THE PRE-TENDER INFORMATION SESSION HELD ON SEPTEMBER 22, 2026 This published notice is not a solicitation. This document does not offer any commitments with respect to future purchases or contracts. The information in this notice is illustrative and may be revised as circumstances change. The purpose of this notice is to inform industry that Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC) intends to establish new Departmental Individual Standing Offers (DISOs) to replace the expiring DISOs under EW699-220114 Multidisciplinary Environmental Services. The new DISOs will include the following consulting services for PWGSC’s Western Region: • Environmental impact assessments, permitting and studies o Environmental impact assessment o Permitting and regulatory support o Biological studies and investigations o Archaeological assessment • Environmental management of federal facilities o Environmental management and compliance o Hazardous building materials surveys o Air quality o Potable water sampling o Storage tank system audits • Contaminated sites consulting services o Phase I, II, III environmental site assessments (ESAs) o Geotechnical assessment o Human health and ecological risk assessment o Climate change risk assessment o Remedial options analyses /Evaluation and remedial action / Risk management action plans • Remediation planning, tender support, and supervision o Remediation planning o Site supervision and contract administration services o Cost estimating PWGSC plans to develop the upcoming multidisciplinary environmental services Request for Standing Offers (RFSOs) with the following structure: Publish four RFSOs on the CanadaBuys tender opportunities website, each aligned to a distinct geographic area and supplier eligibility requirements: 1. Prairies RFSO: Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba 2. Prairies PSIB RFSO: Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba, limited to Indigenous suppliers in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB) 3. Northwest RFSO: Northwest Territories 4. Nunavut RFSO: Nunavut Settlement Area, limited to Inuit firms registered on the Inuit Firm Registry Each RFSO will allow consultant firms to qualify for a DISO for the geographic area covered by that RFSO. ? Consultants may submit offers under more than one RFSO. ? Call-up distribution within each standing offer will be based on pre-determined percentages. ? Each standing offer will include two tiers, with separate call-up procedures as follows: 1. For requirements up to $100,000 (including applicable taxes), PWGSC may either: i. issue the call-up to the next firm on the rotation (rotational call-ups), ii. select the Offeror of their choice (selective call-ups) iii. compete the call-up on the basis of a work plan, level of effort, cost of disbursements and/or travel or Indigenous/Inuit commitments (competitive call-ups). 2. For requirements above $100,000 (including applicable taxes), PWGSC may either: i. issue the call-up to the next firm on the rotation (rotational call-ups), ii. direct a call-up to a firm with ‘best-fit’ justification (‘best fit’ call-ups), or iii. compete the call-up on the basis of a work plan, level of effort, cost of disbursements and/or travel or Indigenous/Inuit commitments (competitive call-ups /the pre-established unit rates of the standing offers will be respected). Each issued call-up will affect the order of priority of rotational call-ups to attain the ideal business volume distribution. Modern Treaties/Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements (CLCAs) Many of the multidisciplinary environmental services tool call-ups will be subject to modern treaties/CLCAs, which define the land and resource rights of Indigenous signatories and are intended to improve the social, cultural, political and economic well-being of the concerned Indigenous peoples. Accordingly, the RFSOs will include socio-economic benefits criteria designed to maximize opportunities for Indigenous businesses, labour, subcontracting and training. The Nunavut stream in particular will be exclusive to firms listed in the Inuit Firm Registry [https://inuitfirm.tunngavik.com]. Vendor Performance Management PWGSC will develop a vendor performance mechanism that is specific to the standing offers. The mechanism is designed to adjust the percentage distribution of call-ups according to the performance of each offeror. Buy Canadian Policy As part of the Government of Canada’s Buy Canadian Procurement Policy, the Policy on Prioritizing Canadian Suppliers and Canadian Content in Strategic Federal Procurements will apply to the RFSOs. Where applicable, each RFSO will include the required clauses and certifications. Optional Pre-Tender Information Session An information session will be held through a Microsoft Teams videoconference meeting on September 22, 2026. The session will begin at 10:00 AM Mountain Daylight Time. If you wish to participate in the information session. Information submitted through the form may be shared with other interested suppliers and may be published online to support industry engagement and collaboration. https://forms-formulaires.alpha.canada.ca/en/id/cmu44qeqe00x501ypgzcgifpn

title: Injectable Egg-Free Influenza Vaccine 2027
description: The Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support is soliciting for the supply of Injectable Egg-Free Influenza Vaccine for the 2027-2028 flu season. Approximately 300,000 doses are included in this requirement. (Quantities may increase or decrease pending receipt of final Service requirements.) The vaccines shall be in prefilled syringes presentation. The vaccine shall be FDA-approved for immunizing individuals 18 years and older. The formula for the 2027-2028 season shall be determined by the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee. Other specification data is included in the solicitation. Successful contractor must have FDA Approval, and the vaccine must be U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommended. National Stock Numbers shall be established at the time of award. An indefinite quantity contract is proposed. The quantity indicated is an annual estimate only. The guaranteed minimum will be 75% of the annual estimate, and a contract maximum will be established at 150% of the annual estimate. Ordered quantities shall be delivered to the Defense Depot New Cumberland, PA. The contractor shall be capable of delivering 40% of the requirement by August 12, 2027, 25% by August 26, 2027, 25% by September 9, 2027, and the residual 10% by September 23, 2027. The Delivery Schedule shall apply to the estimated annual quantity. This delivery schedule is the preferred delivery schedule. Other delivery schedules may be considered. A copy of the solicitation will be posted to the DLA Bid Board System (DIBBS) at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil and SAM.gov at https://www.sam.gov. Interested parties should contact Rosbert Jones (445-737-1254) (Rosbert.Jones@dla.mil) for any questions/comments. Interested parties are further advised to set up automated notifications of presolicitation or solicitation changes through this website. The current projected solicitation date is October of 2026. DLA reserves the right to issue the solicitation before or after the projected solicitation date.

title: 58--OLES LONG RANGE MWIR THERMAL BINOCULARS
description: The Department of the Interior, Bureau of Land Management (BLM), intends to award a sole-source contract to Teledyne FLIR for three Recon HD high-definition, dual-sensor long-range thermal binocular/camera systems with 2� doubler lenses. BLM Law Enforcement currently utilizes legacy Teledyne FLIR Recon long-range, cooled mid-wave infrared (MWIR) thermal systems in remote and austere environments. These systems support law-enforcement missions including suspect detection and identification, detection of small unmanned aircraft systems (sUAS), operational overwatch, search-and-rescue, evidence collection, and reconnaissance. The requirement is for a Section 889-compliant, long-range, lightweight thermal system that integrates a low-light visible camera with a cooled MWIR imager and provides a high-definition 1280 � 720 thermal sensor, High Operating Temperature (HOT) MWIR cryo-cooled focal plane array, 8-micron pixel pitch, and 2� doubler lens. The Recon HD also provides long-range detection capabilities, including specified vehicle detection to 9,700 meters and human detection to 3,900 meters. Based on market research, BLM has identified the Teledyne FLIR Recon HD as the only Section 889-compliant solution that meets BLM's requirements for a long-range, high-definition, cooled MWIR thermal binocular/camera system and interfaces with existing field equipment. BLM intends to pursue this acquisition on a sole-source basis under the authority applicable to only one source being reasonably available. Response to Notice All responsible sources may submit a quotation or capability information demonstrating their ability to satisfy the Government's requirement, which will be considered by the agency. Responses shall be submitted electronically before the end of this announcement period. The Government will consider information received in determining whether a competitive procurement is appropriate.

description: CLARIFICATION REGARDING AUTHORIZED DISTRIBUTOR LETTERS The Government has received questions regarding the requirement to provide "authorized distributor letters" under Section F of the Sources Sought. The Government clarifies the following: Authorized distributor letters are only required for respondents whose proposed solutions include physical hardware, IT equipment, or commercial software licenses. Respondents proposing purely professional services, customized solutions, or approaches that do not involve non-manufactured items, commercial software, or hardware are not required to submit these letters. The omission of authorized distributor letters by services-only respondents will have no impact on the evaluation of capability or the compliance of the submission. All other instructions and the response deadline of 08 October 2026 remain unchanged. Notice: This is not a solicitation but rather a Sources Sought Synopsis to determine potential sources for information and planning purposes only. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine if responsible sources exist, to assist in determining if this effort can be competitive and/or a total Small Business Set-Aside. PLEASE SEE ADDITIONAL ATTACHMENTS FOR FURTHER DETAILS AND VENDOR CAPABILITY QUESTIONS Program Details: The MABSM application is a highly customized, mission-critical Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) system. Originally built on a baseline commercial Impresa MRO/ERP software foundation, the system has undergone extensive, continuous customization over the past 24 years. To date, the MABSM baseline includes over 242,000 custom code changes, program specifications, testing criteria, and complex interface logic. These modifications enable real-time communication with 17 legacy Department of Defense (DoD) systems. This highly specialized, proprietary configuration of the COTS software bears little structural resemblance to its commercial progenitor and operates as a unique hybrid system. MABSM operates and is sustained within the Department of the Air Force's Cloud 1 enterprise cloud environment, leveraging DoD Impact Level 4/5 (IL4/IL5) secure cloud infrastructure. Sourcing specialized contractors who can operate seamlessly within Cloud 1's DevSecOps frameworks, managed services, and security boundaries is crucial to system stability. MABSM dictates the real-time tracking of critical assets, including aircraft parts, financial transactions, and Nuclear Weapons-Related Material (NWRM) items. Due to the high-tempo depot environments in which it is deployed, the system requires a performance baseline exceeding 95% system uptime and near-zero code degradation. Furthermore, national security mandates dictate 100% real-time accountability of NWRM items within any given 24-hour period. description: Amendment 0002 is hereby issued to extend the proposal due date of the SIR to October 9, 2026 at 3:00pm ET. No other changes result from Amendment 0002. Questions and Answers are forthcoming. __________________________________________________ Amendment 0001 is hereby issued to extend the proposal due date of the SIR to September 25, 2026 at 3:00pm ET. No other changes result from Amendment 0001. __________________________________________________ This is the Screening Information Request (SIR) 697DCK-26-R-00423 for the BEYOND Phase 2 Selection. This procurement is in support of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Unmanned Aircraft Systems and Advanced Air Mobility Integration Office (AUS). The FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 (P.L.118-63) Section 920 allows for the expansion of the BEYOND program. The FAA will implement a BEYOND Phase 2 competitive selection process, through this SIR. This competitive selection process is not a procurement or acquisition under the FAA Acquisition Management System. The FAA did not develop any acquisition requirements for this competitive selection process, and the process will not result in the award of a procurement contract. Consistent with the FAA Administrator�s authorities under 49 U.S.C. �106(l) and (m), this process will result in the award of an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA). The FAA intends to award up to eight (8) OTAs through this solicitation. BEYOND Phase 2 has four programmatic focus areas: infrastructure, scalability, safety and automation. Five operational focus areas have also been identified as the greatest challenges that will need to be addressed for progress to be made: public safety, controlled airspace, remote, rural areas with inadequate infrastructure, on-airport operations and cross international borders. This SIR is seeking Offerors who can deliver successful outcomesin support of the BEYOND Phase 2 focus areas. See SIR for details. The FAA intends to competitively award up to eight (8) Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs) with SLTTs in accordance with the SIR. The FAA reserves the right to execute additional OTAs if resources permit (49 U.S.C. � 106(l)). The Government will make OTA awards to the Offeror�s determined to best meet the selection criteria which are included in this SIR and reflected in the evaluation of the proposals. To be considered for award of this requirement, the Offeror must have a current/valid registration in the Systems for Award Management (SAM) database website: www.sam.gov. Registration must be active by the offer due date. Proposals must be submitted via email to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist no later than 3:00 pm ET on September 10, 2026. Please see attached SIR for proposal submission requirements. Questions are to be submitted, in writing, as specified in the SIR. Please reference the SIR number and BEYOND Phase 2 program on all question submissions. All questions must be received no later than 1:00pm ET on September 3, 2026. Prospective Offerors are encouraged to frequently visit SAM.GOV for any updates to this requirement. Any questions regarding this announcement should be directed to Kristin Frantz, Contracting Officer, at Kristin.T.Frantz@faa.gov and Jackson LeMay, Contract Specialist, at Jackson.T.Lemay@faa.gov Any proposals received after the closing date and time, will not be considered in accordance with this SIR. This SIR is not to be construed as a contract or a commitment of any kind. The Government will not be liable for payment of any costs attributed to the preparation and submission of requested proposal documentation.

description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes which to be located within the Kentucky counties of Ballard, Caldwell, Calloway, Carlisle, Crittenden, Fulton, Graves, Hickman, Livingston, Lyon, Marshall, McCracken, Paducah, and Trigg. Home Confinement radius 150-mile not restricted by State or County lines. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March, 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the aforementioned SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four, one-year option period. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 15 beds (12 males and 3 females) for the base year and an estimated maximum 30 beds (25 males and 5 females) facility. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 10 placements (for the base year) and an estimated maximum 20 placements. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. 15BRRC27R00000001 will be available on or about October 9, 2026, and it will be distributed solely through the General Services Administration's Federal Business Opportunities website at https://SAM.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be available. The site provides downloading instructions. Future information about this acquisition will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure that they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The estimated closing date of this solicitation (RFP) will be after 60 days around December 11, 2026. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by this agency. No collect calls will be accepted. No telephone request or written requests for the solicitation will be accepted.

No part of the building shall be within 800 feet of an active, freight carrying railroad track. At least one bus stop shall be located within 800 walkable linear feet. A minimum of 68 public and/or commercial parking spaces for employees and visitors must be available onsite or within 800 walkable linear feet as determined by the Lease Contracting Officer (LCO). Restricted or metered parking of one hour or less within 2 blocks is not acceptable. Offered space shall be located in an office or retail building acceptable to the LCO, with first floor space to be considered most efficient. Space must be on one level without interior ramps, stairs or platforms and shall be contiguous without separation by a public hallway or other area. Odd shaped space and inefficient layouts as determined by the LCO will not be considered. Space shall not be more than twice as long as it is wide Column spacing shall not be less than 20 feet. Offered space shall be visible or easily located from an arterial street as determined by the Lease Contacting Officer. Office space shall be at or above grade with a minimum two accessible egresses. If upper level space is considered, elevator service shall consist of a minimum of two accessible elevators serving the floor proposed for SSA, with both directly available to the reception area. At least one must function during power outages. Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease. A fully serviced lease is required. Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance floodplain (formerly referred to as �100-year� floodplain).
